_comment: The one place for the values Joshua owns. siteOrigin is where GitHub Pages serves the site. securityContact (a mailto:, https: or tel: URI) and securityTxtExpires (an ISO date within a year) fill /.well-known/security.txt; while either is null the file says so and security.html says the contact is not published yet. Nothing here is invented: fill them in or leave them null.
